svg.title: Golgi
svg.desc: Polarized Golgi stack with cis and trans faces, flattened cisternae, and incoming and budding transport vesicles. Biological basis: Golgi cisternae modify and sort biosynthetic cargo as it moves from the cis entry face toward the trans-Golgi network.
